payload.prompt: General Graardor wears Bandosian war armour, but what is he wearing on his feet?
payload.explanation: Nothing at all: his model on the OSRS Wiki shows bare feet below the armour.

payload.prompt: Which of Vorkath's eyes is torn out and scarred shut?
payload.explanation: His left, as his model on the OSRS Wiki shows.

payload.prompt: How many toes does the King Black Dragon have?
payload.explanation: Twelve: three clawed toes on each of his four feet, counted on his model on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: What is Zulrah's combat level?
payload.explanation: 725, per Zulrah's infobox on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: In what year was Vorkath released?
payload.explanation: 4 January 2018, together with Dragon Slayer II, per Vorkath's infobox on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: On which island does Elvarg, the dragon from Dragon Slayer I, live?
payload.explanation: Crandor: she lives in the dungeon below it, per her OSRS Wiki page.

payload.prompt: Where does the Giant Mole live?
payload.explanation: In the Mole Hole under Falador Park, per the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: What race is General Graardor?
payload.explanation: An ourg, and the only known living one, per his OSRS Wiki page.

payload.prompt: What is the King Black Dragon's combat level?
payload.explanation: 276, per his infobox on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: Which god does Nex serve?
payload.explanation: Zaros: she is one of his most powerful followers, per her OSRS Wiki page.

payload.prompt: Which demon, imprisoned beneath Prifddinas, is fought with a pickaxe instead of a weapon?
payload.explanation: Zalcano, a skilling boss, per the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: In what year was Zulrah released?
payload.explanation: 8 January 2015, per Zulrah's infobox on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: Which item shows where the Giant Mole has burrowed to?
payload.explanation: A Falador shield 3 or better in your inventory, per the OSRS Wiki's Giant Mole page.

payload.prompt: Which quest unlocks the fight against Vorkath?
payload.explanation: Dragon Slayer II: Vorkath is fought after it, per the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: How many Hitpoints does the Corporeal Beast have?
payload.explanation: 2,000, per the Corporeal Beast's infobox on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: Which boss waits at the end of the TzHaar Fight Cave?
payload.explanation: TzTok-Jad, per the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: Sort these Fight Caves monsters by combat level, lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Each roughly doubles the last: Tz-Kih 22, Tz-Kek 45, Tok-Xil 90, Yt-MejKot 180, Ket-Zek 360 and TzTok-Jad 702, per their infoboxes on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: Sort the God Wars Dungeon generals by combat level, lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Kree'arra is level 580, Commander Zilyana 596, General Graardor 624 and K'ril Tsutsaroth 650, per their infoboxes on the OSRS Wiki.

payload.prompt: Sort these dragons by combat level, lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Blue dragons are level 111, lava 252, mithril 304, brutal black 318, adamant 338 and rune 380, per their infoboxes on the OSRS Wiki. A brutal black outranks a mithril dragon.

payload.prompt: Without transmorphs and duplicate versions, how many unique pets can you obtain in Gielinor?
payload.explanation: There are currently 71 available pets in Old School RuneScape.

payload.prompt: Which of these monsters are demons?
payload.explanation: Greater demons, hellhounds and abyssal demons, all weak to demonbane; hellhounds were tagged demonic in 2021. Gargoyles are golems and kurasks are leafy.

payload.prompt: Which skilling pet has the most metamorphosis options?
payload.explanation: The rock golem can take on 19 different forms! It is followed by the rift guardian and beaver with 16 each.

payload.prompt: Which of these pets doesn't wear a hat around Christmas time?
payload.explanation: Fun fact - the three-headed Prince Black Dragon even wears three different hats.

payload.prompt: Which of these bosses has a speed-based combat achievement?
payload.explanation: Out of these, only the Mad Angel has such a combat achievement. It is earnt by killing her 5 times within 10 minutes of entering her arena.

payload.prompt: Which of these monsters drop regular ashes when killed?
payload.explanation: Ghosts and shadow warriors don't drop any remains, whereas catablepons drop regular bones.

payload.prompt: Which of these bosses will never drop a jar?
payload.explanation: Vorkath may drop the Jar of Decay, the Corporeal Beast the Jar of Spirits, and the Nightmare the Jar of Souls.

payload.prompt: Match each boss to where it is fought.
payload.explanation: The Karuulm Slayer Dungeon holds the Alchemical Hydra, and Lithkren's vault its metal dragons.

payload.prompt: Pick all that are true for the King Black Dragon.
payload.explanation: He has a 50% weakness to water spells

payload.prompt: How many teeth does the Leviathan have?
payload.explanation: This big fish has a total of 18 teeth! Did you ever think to count them?

payload.prompt: What is the colour of Commander Zilyana's eyes?
payload.explanation: Her eyes are a bright white!

payload.prompt: Which of these are true of Kree'arra?
payload.explanation: Kree'arra is a general with a golden-coloured beak and has only two wings.

payload.prompt: How many different monsters have the Godsword shards on their drop table?
payload.explanation: Each of the 4 generals and each of their 4 sergeants can drop the Godsword shards!

payload.prompt: How many legs and/or arms does a Turoth have?
payload.explanation: Turoths have a total of three! Two at the front and one at the back.

payload.prompt: At least how much does your equipment need to weigh (in kg) to counter the Shellbane gryphon's knockback attack?
What is the name of the leaping monster spawned by the Corporeal Beast?
What boss is based on a real-life praying mantis?
payload.explanation: The Doom of Mokhaiotl even has a combat achievement called "The Praying Mantis".

payload.prompt: Select the bosses that use all three combat styles.
payload.explanation: These bosses can all use magic and ranged attacks. Only Hespori can't attack with melee as well.

payload.prompt: What is the monkey settlement on Ape Atoll called?
How many greater demons can be found in the God Wars Dungeon?
payload.explanation: Only K'ril Tsutsaroth and his bodyguard Tstanon Karlak are considered greater demons. His other two bodyguards are a black demon and a lesser demon.

payload.prompt: What is the name of the weapon held by the Mad Angel?
Which piece of jewellery is seen in the area where the Mimic is fought?
What item can be given to Brutus to turn him into a powerful demonic version of himself?
Select the monsters that take additional damage from granite hammers.
payload.explanation: Granite hammers have improved accuracy and damage against monsters classified as a golem. While the earth elemental and Tekton both appear as golems, they are not actually considered golems.

payload.prompt: What race is Commander Zilyana, Saradomin's general in the God Wars Dungeon?
payload.explanation: Commander Zilyana is an icyene, a winged humanoid race aligned with Saradomin.

payload.prompt: Where in Gielinor do the Dagannoth Kings live?
payload.explanation: Dagannoth Rex, Prime and Supreme dwell in the lowest cavern of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon.

payload.prompt: Which Dagannoth King attacks solely with Melee?
payload.explanation: Rex uses Melee, Prime uses Magic and Supreme uses Ranged — forming the combat triangle.

payload.prompt: Where is Scurrius, the Rat King, fought?
payload.explanation: Scurrius lurks in a lair inside the Varrock Sewers, introduced in January 2024 as an entry-level PvM boss.

payload.prompt: Which two elemental giants clash in the Royal Titans encounter?
options: Branda the Fire Queen and Eldric the Ice King
Obor the Hill King and Bryophyta the Moss Queen
payload.explanation: Branda the Fire Queen (from Karamja Volcano) and Eldric the Ice King (from Asgarnian Ice Dungeon) face off as the Royal Titans.

payload.prompt: Which of the six Barrows brothers fights using Magic?
payload.explanation: Ahrim the Blighted casts Fire Wave and stat-draining curses; Karil uses Ranged and the other four use Melee.

payload.prompt: What kind of creature is Kephri, the boss of the Path of Scabaras in the Tombs of Amascut?
payload.explanation: Kephri is a giant dawn scarab with the kalphite attribute, guarding the Path of Scabaras.

payload.prompt: Which free-to-play boss is fought by unlocking a lair in the Varrock Sewers with a mossy key?
payload.explanation: Bryophyta is the level-128 moss giant boss in Varrock Sewers; Obor is the hill giant boss in Edgeville Dungeon.

payload.prompt: What race is Kree'arra, Armadyl's general in the God Wars Dungeon?
payload.explanation: Kree'arra is an aviansie, a proud race of bird-like warriors devoted to Armadyl.

payload.prompt: Which attribute does the Phantom Muspah carry in its monster infobox?
payload.explanation: The Phantom Muspah has the spectral attribute (though it is not undead, so the salve amulet does not work on it).

payload.prompt: Which boss waits at the end of wave 69 of the Inferno?
payload.explanation: TzKal-Zuk, level 1,400, is the final boss of the Inferno.

payload.prompt: Which hill giant boss can free-to-play players fight in Edgeville Dungeon using a giant key?
payload.explanation: Obor is a level-106 hill giant boss whose lair lies inside Edgeville Dungeon.

payload.prompt: Which boss serves as the final champion of the Fortis Colosseum in Varlamore?
payload.explanation: Sol Heredit (combat level 1,563) awaits challengers on wave 12 of the Fortis Colosseum.

payload.prompt: Which archaic demon boss is summoned beneath the Catacombs of Kourend using a dark totem?
payload.explanation: Offering a dark totem at the altar in the centre of the Catacombs of Kourend teleports you to Skotizo's lair.

payload.prompt: What is the name of the vampyre ruler fought as the final boss of the Theatre of Blood?
payload.explanation: Lady Verzik Vitur rules the Theatre of Blood in Ver Sinhaza and transforms into an arachnid Nylocas hybrid in her final phase.

payload.prompt: Which of these bosses are unlocked by completing Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire?
payload.explanation: Duke Sucellus, Vardorvis, The Leviathan and The Whisperer are the four Desert Treasure II bosses; Phantom Muspah comes from Secrets of the North.

payload.prompt: Which of these monsters carry the draconic attribute?
payload.explanation: Great Olm, Alchemical Hydra, The Hueycoatl and skeletal wyverns all have the draconic attribute; Zulrah and Elvarg are excluded.

payload.prompt: Despite looking ghostly or undead, which of these are NOT classified as undead in Old School RuneScape?
payload.explanation: Barrows brothers (wights), spiritual creatures and ghouls do not have the undead attribute, so the salve amulet does not work on them. Vorkath and Vet'ion are undead.

payload.prompt: What is TzKal-Zuk's combat level?
payload.explanation: TzKal-Zuk is combat level 1,400 with 1,200 Hitpoints.

payload.prompt: How many Hitpoints does Nex have?
payload.explanation: Nex has 3,400 Hitpoints (and combat level 1,001), with a mage becoming vulnerable every 680 HP lost.

payload.prompt: What is the combat level of each of the three Dagannoth Kings?
payload.explanation: Dagannoth Rex, Prime and Supreme are all combat level 303 with 255 Hitpoints.

payload.prompt: What is Sol Heredit's combat level?
payload.explanation: Sol Heredit is combat level 1,563 with 1,500 Hitpoints.

payload.prompt: How many waves are there in the Inferno, including TzKal-Zuk?
payload.explanation: The Inferno has 69 waves, six more than the 63 waves of the TzHaar Fight Cave.

payload.prompt: In what year was the King Black Dragon first released in RuneScape?
payload.explanation: 24 September 2002, making the King Black Dragon one of RuneScape's oldest bosses.

payload.prompt: In what year was the Kalphite Queen first released in RuneScape?
payload.explanation: 7 September 2004, arriving alongside the famous dragon chainbody drop.

payload.prompt: Sort these Wilderness bosses by combat level, lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Scorpia is level 225, Chaos Elemental 305, Vet'ion 454, Venenatis 464 and Callisto 470.

payload.prompt: Sort the four post-quest Desert Treasure II bosses by combat level, lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Post-quest combat levels are Duke Sucellus 758, Vardorvis 784, The Whisperer 791 and The Leviathan 798.

payload.prompt: Match each Barrows brother to his signature weapon.
payload.explanation: Ahrim wields a staff and Torag dual-wields hammers.

payload.prompt: Match each Desert Treasure II boss to the pet it drops.
payload.explanation: Muphin comes from the Phantom Muspah and Huberte from The Hueycoatl.

payload.prompt: Match each Tombs of Amascut demi-boss to the path it guards.
payload.explanation: Apmeken's path leads to Ba-Ba, Scabaras to Kephri, Het to Akkha and Crondis to Zebak.
